arm64.note: Uses the Microsoft WebView2 Runtime, which is part of Windows 11 and of up-to-date Windows 10. If Mosaic asks for it, install it from Microsoft and start Mosaic again.

x86.note: Uses the Microsoft WebView2 Runtime, which is part of Windows 11 and of up-to-date Windows 10. If Mosaic asks for it, install it from Microsoft and start Mosaic again.

arm.note: A .deb package. Install it with: sudo apt install ./<downloaded file> Works on Raspberry Pi OS 32-bit for the Pi 2 and newer.

x86.note: A .deb package. Install it with: sudo apt install ./<downloaded file>

universal.note: This build is not signed by Apple, so iOS will not run it as it is. Re-sign it with your own Apple ID using AltStore, Sideloadly, TrollStore or Xcode, then install it. It is not on the App Store yet.
